recipe.build:
FLUTTER_VERSION="$(jq -r '.flutter' .fvmrc)"
git clone -b $FLUTTER_VERSION https://github.com/flutter/flutter
export PUB_CACHE=$(pwd)/.pub-cache NO_SIGNING=true
flutter/bin/flutter config --no-analytics
flutter/bin/flutter pub get
flutter/bin/flutter build apk --release --split-per-abi --flavor store
find . -name '*.apk'
mv build/app/outputs/apk/store/release/app-store-arm64-v8a-release.apk /outputs/unsigned.apk

mv build/app/outputs/apk/store/release/app-store-arm64-v8a-release.apk /outputs/unsigned.apk

mv build/app/outputs/apk/store/release/app-store-arm64-v8a-release.apk /outputs/unsigned.apk
